title: Practice: Past active participles: прочитавший, принёсший, шедший

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The war lasting for years impoverished the country.
exercises.why: The past active participle, like the present active participle, is a verbal adjective; it denotes the performer of an action which took place in the past. It can be formed both from perfective and imperfective verbs: *писавший* = который писал; *написавший* = который написал. Group 1: verbs ending in -л in the past tense. The participle is formed from the past tense (masculine) by dropping -л and adding the suffix -вш- before the adjectival ending: проверял — проверявший; проверил — проверивший. From -ся verbs, -ся (never -сь) is added after the adjectival ending: мылся — мывшийся. Group 2: verbs ending in the past tense (masc.) in any other consonant but -л add the suffix -ш- + adjectival… — DLI, Lessons 94 and 95.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The past active participle, like the present active participle, is a verbal adjective; it denotes the performer of an action which took place in the past. (DLI, Lessons 94 and 95)
